jobs.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. The Role As a member of the US Talent Acquisition team focused on Research and technical hiring, you will be instrumental in building and scaling Mistral's US-based research and engineering teams from the ground up. Joining early means you'll help shape both our technical recruitment strategy and operations, partnering closely with Research leadership across Research Science, Research Engineering, and adjacent technical functions. Own full-cycle recruitment across Research Science and Research Engineering, with flexibility to support other technical roles as they come along - Advise hiring managers on market mapping, leveling, comp positioning, and the competitive landscape for US research and engineering talent - Translate the nuances of each technical role into compelling, accurate candidate outreach End-to-End Technical Recruitment - Own the full recruiting lifecycle from sourcing to close, operating with autonomy on complex, competitive technical roles - Source passive and active candidates across US research and engineering talent pools — from PhD students and postdocs to experienced researchers and engineers at leading AI labs, universities, and technology companies - Conduct intake and calibration sessions with hiring managers to align on ideal candidate profiles and stage expectations - Drive efficient, high-conversion pipelines and close candidates in a fiercely competitive market for top research talent Candidate Experience & Selling Mistral - Guide candidates through the hiring process with clear communication and a compelling narrative about Mistral's mission, culture, and trajectory - Articulate Mistral's positioning in the AI landscape — frontier models, open-weight philosophy, and research credibility — to differentiate us against better-resourced labs - Provide candidates with real insight into our research agenda, compute access, publication culture, and the specific impact of their role - Deliver a high-quality, respectful candidate experience at every stage, regardless of outcome Recruiting Operations & Data-Driven Improvement - Partner on employer-brand and outbound sourcing initiatives — including academic pipelines, conference presence, and open-source community engagement — that position Mistral as a destination for top research and engineering talent What We're Looking For - 6+ years of recruiting experience, including 2+ years in a startup or high-growth environment, with a focus on Research Science and Research Engineering roles - Demonstrated ability to independently hire across the technical stack — from Research Engineers to Research Scientists, and senior research talent - Deep network and sourcing expertise in US research and engineering talent markets, with credibility in AI/ML and ideally connections across top labs and universities - Track record of hiring in competitive, candidate-scarce markets where top researchers have multiple offers -
